0022600015.text: The Wizards host the Hornets in the sixth game of Washington's season and the East Group C Emirates NBA Cup matchup. Washington is 2-3 overall, 1-1 at home, on a two-game losing streak, third in the Southeast one game back and ninth in the East, while Charlotte is 3-2, first in the Southeast and fifth in the East after a one-game skid. Out for Washington are Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie and Tristan Vukcevic, with Tre Johnson day-to-day from Achilles soreness, and out for Charlotte are Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, with Dennis Schroder day-to-day from a foot injury. The Wizards trail the season series 0-1 after a 110-103 loss in Charlotte on October 26, 2026, and they were swept 0-4 by the Hornets in 2025-26.
